description: TU Delft provides an X-band radar resource describing hydrodynamic and bathymetry measurements at the Sand Motor. Separately identified annual members describe 2013, 2014 and 2015 subsets. This parent resource retains its own native identity. Coverage: Complete observation dates are unstated.. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The parent description does not establish a complete observation period, annual completeness or the variables and inversion methods. Parent and annual inventories are preserved separately without claiming nonoverlapping observations. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
